item.title: Pretty chandeliers! Has a guest apartment. One acre in West Virginia. $289,000
item.description: This house has some pretty chandeliers! There is a guest apartment over the garage. The house was built in 1940. It is located on one acre in Welch, West Virginia. The house features a covered side porch, wood floors, baseboards, nice staircase, chair rails, crystal chandeliers, wainscoting and built-in corner cabinets. There is a detached garage with a breezeway. Above the garage is a guest apartment with two rooms and a full bathroom. The house has a finished basement. Four bedrooms, four bath

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Ten acres in Wisconsin. $195,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! The setting looks nice. The house was built in 1910. It is located on ten acres in Merrill, Wisconsin. The house definitely needs work, there are signs of water damage so the roof needs to be looked at. There is eight acres of open pastureland that could be used for gardening or animals. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,846 square feet. $195,000 Contact Lora Bladow with RE/MAX Excel: 715-218-9666 From the Zillow listing: If you

item.title: Love the vintage bathroom! Diamond in the Rough in Alabama. $125,000
item.description: I am in love with that vintage bathroom! I want it! This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! It was built in 1928. It is located on .37 acre in Birmingham, Alabama. The house features mature landscaping, a covered front porch, wood floors, arched entryway, crown moulding, baseboards, vintage bathroom and a spacious kitchen. There are nice views overlooking the town. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,793 square feet. $125,000 Contact Cerita Tucker Smith with ReGroup Sales and Developm

item.title: Sweet house! Short drive up to the mountains! Over an acre in NC. $169,900
item.description: This is a sweet house! It’s just a short drive up to the mountains. I like the exposed beams. The house was built in 1945. It is located on 1.24 acres in Lenoir, North Carolina. The house features some wood floors, exposed ceiling beams, brick fireplace, built-in bookshelves and a lot of natural light. There is a detached building with a carport. It could use some undoing of past renovations, but this is a nice house at a great price. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,318 square feet. $169,900

item.title: Nice porch! Pretty interior! Circa 1893 in Colorado. $335,000
item.description: This house has a nice porch! There is a pretty interior also. The house was built in 1893. It is located in Canon City, Colorado. The house features a unique porch, wood floors, transom window, arched entryway, baseboards, crown moulding and vintage light fixture. The kitchen could use some work. There is a fenced in backyard with a deck. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,792 square feet. $335,000 Contact J. P. item.title: Circa 1735 in Connecticut! Not afraid of color! $420,000
item.description: This is a very early house! Love those big fireplaces! They were not scared of color! This Samuel Stoughton built house was constructed in 1735. It is located on .44 acre in Windsor, Connecticut. The house features wood floors, large fireplaces, wainscoting, baseboards, paneled den, spacious kitchen, sunroom and a claw foot tub. There is a detached garage, detached storage shed and a large deck. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,448 square feet. $420,000 Contact Julie L. Bushnell with Connecti

item.title: Porch goals! Love this house! Circa 1910 in Florida. $395,000
item.description: Porch goals! Love this house! It has character! The house was built in 1910. It is located Apalachicola, Florida. The house features a large wrap around front porch, original wood floors, arched entryway, bead board for days, wainscoting, chair rails and original mantels. The kitchen definitely needs work. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,297 square feet. $395,000 Contact Shelley Shepard with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices: 850-653-6621 From the Zillow listing: Short term rentals allowed – z

item.title: Nice porch! Nine acres in Georgia. Multiple fruit trees! $225,000
item.description: This has a great porch! There are multiple fruit trees on the property! The house was built in 1900. It is located on nine acres in Tignall, Georgia. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, french doors, bead board, crown moulding, baseboards and claw foot tub. The property has peach trees, pear trees, pecan and walnut trees. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,861 square feet. $225,000 Contact Marc Richards with Waldorf Real Estate: 706-401-4088 From the Zil

item.title: Nice landscaping and curb appeal! Circa 1945 in Illinois. $399,900
item.description: This house has professional landscaping and a lot of nice curb appeal! The house was built in 1945. It is located on .38 acre in Melrose Park, Illinois. The house features wood floors, wood burning fireplace, two kitchens, unique staircase, baseboards and updated bathrooms. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,700 square feet. $399,900 Contact Patrizia Vicari with Skyward Realty: 847-606-7079 From the Zillow listing: Fabulous curb appeal on this lovel

item.title: Love the bookcases and the pool! Circa 1890 in Indiana. $350,000
item.description: Love those bookcases! And the pool was a nice surprise! The house was built in 1890. It is located on .27 acre in Terre Haute, Indiana. The house features nice curb appeal, large stone chimney, covered side porch, wood floors, pretty fireplace, crown moulding, wide baseboards, amazing bookcases, updated kitchen and a vintage bathroom. The backyard has a beautiful in-ground pool. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,926 square feet. $350,000 Contact Joe Everhart with Everhart Studio From the Zil
